question: How many Congolese miners die every day, according to the UN?
answer: The UN estimates that about 1,000 Congolese miners die each day. That figure counts gold, cobalt and diamond mines as well as coltan, where conditions are often as bad. It works out to one miner every 86 seconds. No one keeps an exact count.
move: Behind cheap minerals, around 1,000 Congolese miners die each day.
